title: Cien mil me gusta
brief: You're yourself, with Vale, who is your age, so use tú. A photo of the chalkboard has gone viral, and she keeps showing you her phone. Answer with the wishes and exclamations Spanish uses for surprise, hope and regret.

turns.npc: Vale: Tomás, mira el celular: la foto de la pizarra ya tiene cien mil me gusta.
turns.npcEn: Vale: Tomás, look at the phone: the photo of the chalkboard already has a hundred thousand likes.
turns.intent: Say who would have thought it (use: ¡Quién lo hubiera dicho!).

turns.npc: Vale: Y el hotel ni contesta.
turns.npcEn: Vale: And the hotel doesn't even answer.
turns.intent: Wish they would at least reply (use: ¡Si al menos...! with the past subjunctive).
accept: ¡Si al menos nos escribieran un mensaje!
¡Si al menos pidieran perdón por la música!

turns.npc: Vale: ¿Sabías que esto iba a pasar?
turns.npcEn: Vale: Did you know this was going to happen?
turns.intent: Insist that of course: you already told her (use: ¡Si ya te lo dije!).
accept: ¡Pero si ya te lo dije, Vale!

turns.npc: Vale: Hernando quiere que escribas tú el chiste de mañana.
turns.npcEn: Vale: Hernando wants you to write tomorrow's joke.
turns.intent: Voice a regret: you wish you had never said yes (use: ¡Ojalá nunca...!).
accept: ¡Ojalá nunca le hubiera dicho que sí!

turns.npc: Vale: Bueno, famoso. ¿Pan o buñuelo para celebrar?
turns.npcEn: Vale: Well, famous man. Bread or a fritter to celebrate?
turns.intent: Choose one and say you'll pay for the coffee.
accept: Pan, y el café lo pago yo.
Buñuelo, por favor, y hoy invito yo.
Un pan, gracias. El café va por mi cuenta.
